BiblicalUsage: Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth stand among the Levites of the second degree who brought up the ark. The singers with psalteries stand in the same company.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the second degree matters as much as the first: Jaaziel stood with the rest who brought the ark up, and the ark came up because every rank did its part.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
